address: 855 El Camino Real #120, Palo Alto, CA 94301
w: The Palo Alto outpost of the cult Bay Area bubble-tea brand (founded in SF's Mission, 2011) that helped push American boba upscale — house-brewed organic teas, Straus Family Creamery milk and hand-cooked tapioca in the signature jasmine milk tea. Open (verified Aug 2026).

dish: iced sea salt coffee + marble taro bread
w: The Taiwanese bakery-cafe juggernaut whose Cupertino store draws constant trays-and-tongs crowds; the famous iced sea salt coffee (cold brew capped with a salty-sweet cream float) and the marble taro bread are the must-grabs. The Milpitas branch has closed; this one is open (verified Aug 2026).

dish: taro ball + grass jelly herbal jelly bowl
address: 19449 Stevens Creek Blvd Ste 120, Cupertino, CA 95014
w: A destination for authentic Taiwanese dessert (the chain began in Taichung, 1996); the signature is a warm bowl of hand-made Q-chewy taro balls over silky herbal grass jelly with red bean and taro. Open (verified Mar 2026).

The South Bay branch of the San Mateo-born chain (started by Alex Su out of a downtown San Mateo shop) that became a Bay Area boba phenomenon on the back of its honey boba and mix-and-match flavor wall. Open (verified Aug 2026).

dish: tie guan yin milk tea with cheese cream foam
w: Cupertino outpost of the Taiwanese brand TP Tea (茶湯會), from the founding family behind Chatime; the roasted tie guan yin milk tea crowned with salty cheese cream foam is the pick, with chewy house pearls. Open (verified Aug 2026).

address: 4750 Almaden Expy Ste 136, San Jose, CA 95118
w: A Silicon Valley-born boba brand (founded 2019 by local engineers) that leans on fresh-fruit teas and cheese-foam toppings; now several South Bay shops strong. Open (verified Jul 2026).

dish: brown sugar fresh milk with pearls
w: West San Jose shop of the Taiwanese chain Tea Top, a boba-scene staple for its brown sugar fresh milk with warm chewy pearls and jasmine milk tea. Open (verified Jul 2026).

address: 2936 Aborn Square Rd, San Jose, CA 95121
w: A long-running Taiwanese-style boba spot on San Jose's east side known for a big roster of milk teas and slushes; the Okinawa and Hokkaido milk teas are the go-tos. Open (verified Aug 2026).

address: 1728 Hostetter Rd Ste 30, San Jose, CA 95131
w: San Jose branch of the global Taiwanese chain Sharetea (est. 1992), a reliable pour for classic pearl milk tea and QQ (pearl + herbal jelly) toppings. Open (verified Apr 2026).

The iconic community cafe smack in the middle of downtown Mountain View's Castro Street — red walls, a laptop-packed upstairs loft, and a beloved Monday open-mic; a South Bay institution for founders, students and artists. Open (verified Jul 2026).

address: 5237 Stevens Creek Blvd, Santa Clara, CA 95051
w: A Santa Clara third-wave roaster-cafe (roasting since 2012) that's a serious-coffee anchor of the Valley; pull a single-origin espresso or grab house-roasted beans alongside local pastries. Open (verified 2026).

A contemporary specialty cafe in downtown San Jose's SoFA District, prized for thoughtfully roasted coffee and creative espresso drinks like the banana matcha latte, plus fresh pastries. (The old 169 W Santa Clara St location closed; this S 2nd St flagship is open — verified Aug 2026.)

Downtown San Jose's first Black-owned coffeehouse, opened by sisters Jeronica Macey and Be'Anka Ashaolu — a warm SoFA gathering spot with quality espresso, a soulful vibe and a strong community following. Open (verified Aug 2026).

A geeky West San Jose specialty roaster that roasts single-origin beans in-store on a zero-emissions roaster and brews with mineral-tuned water — one of the Valley's most precise cups. Open (verified Aug 2026).

dish: Verve espresso in a 1930s gas station
w: A San Jose Japantown landmark: the corner Mobil station 'Grandpa Roy' Murotsune ran for decades (his family bought it after returning from WWII internment), converted in 2009 into a warm cafe pouring Verve coffee with the vintage pumps still in view. Open.

dish: proper espresso on a leafy patio
w: A neighborhood-staple San Jose roaster with warm wood interiors and a laid-back patio where regulars bring dogs and laptops; solid espresso and house-roasted beans. Open (verified Aug 2026).

address: 50 W Main St, Los Gatos, CA 95030
w: A downtown Los Gatos bakery institution since 1985; the from-scratch banana cake has a cult following, alongside handmade cupcakes, cookies and celebration cakes. Open (verified Aug 2026).
An indoor/outdoor French patisserie on Santana Row baking daily — croissants, tarts, cakes and a rainbow of macarons, plus baguette sandwiches; open late on weekends. Open (verified Aug 2026).
The Cupertino branch of the Bay Area's Taiwanese-style bakery chain near Apple Park; go for the soft milk breads, taro buns and coffee-cream loaves, plus milk tea to go. Open (verified Aug 2026).

address: 3159 Mission College Blvd, Santa Clara, CA 95054
w: The Korean-founded French-style bakery cafe; the Santa Clara store turns out the fluffy strawberry soft-cream cake, pastries and coffee that made the brand a Bay Area staple. Open (verified Jun 2026).

address: 2855 Stevens Creek Blvd Ste 9254, Santa Clara, CA 95050
w: A Uji-matcha specialist inside Westfield Valley Fair known for stone-ground matcha soft serve and layered parfaits with red bean, mochi and shiratama. Open (verified Aug 2026).
